note: 63 accepted P1 foot strikes originate from 44 unique FOOT_CONTACT groups. Production sends one generic substrate excitation per group, so this report preserves those 44 mapped payloads rather than duplicating group events to force 63.

eventMapping.rule: Match each accepted P1 born strike to exactly one same-timestamp FOOT_CONTACT leg and its SurfaceField response by exact position; deduplicate parent contact-group index; select that group’s original legacy-strike payload once.
eventMapping.originalGroupScheduleEmissionOrder: retained for equal-frame rows using original recording index

measurements.units: linear float32 full-scale; dBFS uses 20*log10(rms or peak)

eventAlignedMedianRms.alignmentSchedule: all 63 accepted P1 strike frames; duplicate frames retain P1 route multiplicity

decomposition.interpretation: The first term reflects both lower event count and selection of P1-supporting groups; the raw comparison also includes production-mapped group-centroid/strength versus per-foot excitation payloads and different worklet/resonator/readout paths; the third is the fixed external bridge/output gain difference. These are level decompositions, not psychoacoustic masking measurements.

capture.rawOutputDefinition: Direct AudioWorklet output branch before the external bridge/output GainNode; includes each worklet’s internal processing and limiter.
capture.allEventsRawDerivation: Existing all-events configured float32 PCM divided sample-by-sample by its fixed static 0.0539 bridge/output gain; original configured WAV kept unchanged.
capture.genericPlateRandomness: The unchanged generic worklet uses production Math.random strike jitter; the frozen event schedule is exact, but a fresh PCM replay may have a different noise realization.

renderer.eventMarkers: 44 unique matched FOOT_CONTACT groups plus P1 birth at audio 0 s
